scope: Owned SubRip and MPL2 parser lifecycles in experimental document configuration; full-library goal remains active.

operations.operation: Owned file/caption lifecycle and timestamp policy
operations.behavior: Raw UTF16 ownership, supplied CString whitespace predicates, header rejection, persistent SubRip blank-line boundary state, numeric boundary consumption, inner versus outer EOF policy, caption accumulation, full-millisecond wrapping SRT times, MPL2 decisecond times and second-bracket/Mid extraction. Live document nonemptiness decides success at outer EOF; explicit format rejection remains false even with preloaded entries.

The session models tmp+newline followed by CString append: a supplied embedded NUL truncates the fragment and suppresses its appended newline. Actual pinned ReadString uses CString Append earlier and already truncates each file line at NUL, so file-level rendering checks observe discarded suffix text, not that unreachable inner-fragment newline distinction. No Unicode scalar normalization.

operations.operation: Initialized native conversion and callback boundary
operations.behavior: ReadString, IsSpace, scanf_s, SubRipper2SSA/MPL22SSA and Add remain services outside all registry loans. SubRip count>=11 is required before serializing h/m/s locals; each secondary millisecond parse defaults to0 if count!=2. MPL2 copies only its two successful conversions. All unused transport slots are initialized zero. No native partial-scan uninitialized value is inspected.

boundary_review.contract: Document-bound never-reused integer IDs under nonblocking admission. All raw input, predicates and i32 packets copied before mutation; strict bools/format/count/phase/packet shapes checked. Snapshot and begin output preflight precedes publication. Immutable snapshots survive run/document destruction; no native pointer retained. Native conversion/formatting/Add occur outside registry admission. Busy handling, allocation timing/failure and allocator reentry remain outside compatibility closure.

direct_probe.method: Actual STS.cpp with initialized linked document observer; empty/pre-populated document variants, partial scans, extreme integers, malformed separators/brackets, final fragments, raw units, persistent caption boundaries. Two reference and two candidate executions per architecture compare complete documents, exceptions and byte positions.

rendering.corrected_control: Initial text-new reports had matching output in all20 cases but failed the SRT NUL distinct-image assertion because the reader truncated the tail before parsing, making the selected images identical. Commit7e5440d5 corrected the non-NUL control to contain the visible suffix. Initial failed control reports remain separate and are not passing evidence.

limits: No production default switch or full format/frontend/host closure.
Remaining scanf, formatter, encoding, Add and file adapters are transitional native code.
Native pre-Open simplicity, allocation failure/reentry and real player/Aegisub integration remain unresolved.
No new non-Windows, Miri or default native-document runtime parity; default configuration has compile probes only.
Finite MSVC14.44 local Windows evidence; no crash, timeout or unstable outcome is treated as equality.
next_work: Continue moving the remaining text-format parser control and ownership into safe Rust.
Replace native numeric, encoding, formatting and file adapters with audited system boundaries and safe policy.
Continue complete rendering, public host/ABI and vendored native replacement; retire fallback/raw adapters as callers move.
